“Wands”, attributed to Fire; “Cups”, to Water; “Swords”, to Air;

quotes.quote: The card also refers to Venus in Cancer.

sections.title: What it figures
sections.line: Crowley on the Two as the Word and the Will, and on the harmony of the male and the female (pdf p197).

quotes.quote: The Two always represents the Word and the Will. It is the first manifestation.
It shows the harmony of the male and the female: interpreted in the largest sense.
